d: You pay a visit to your local all-night diner. A spot at the bar is open, waiting just for you. As you take a seat and glance at the familiar menu, the bartender already starts preparing your favorite drink. Someone's pouring coins into the jukebox, queuing up some tunes. Something jazzy, something smooth. You enjoy your first sips, tapping your toes. The rest, you know, is history.
